'''Henry Kressel''' (born c. 1934) is an American engineer, scientist, and financial executive.

In 1980, Kressel was elected a member of the [[National Academy of Engineering]] for pioneering research in opto-electronic devices with specific emphasis on semiconductor lasers.

He is a partner and the senior managing director of the [[private equity]] firm [[Warburg Pincus]].<ref name="wp">{{cite web|url=http://www.warburgpincus.com/people/ViewEmployee,employeeid,69.aspx |title=Henry Kressel |publisher=warburgpincus.com. [[Warburg Pincus]] |accessdate=2012-01-15 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20111219143140/http://www.warburgpincus.com/people/ViewEmployee%2Cemployeeid%2C69.aspx |archivedate=2011-12-19 }}</ref>

He has been a board member of [[SRI International]] since 2001.<ref name="sri">{{cite web|url=http://www.sri.com/about/people/henry-kressel|title=Henry Kressel|publisher=[[SRI International]]|accessdate=2013-07-01}}</ref><ref name="elects">{{cite news|url=http://www.sri.com/news/releases/10-16-01.html|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120119042145/http://www.sri.com/news/releases/10-16-01.html|archivedate=2012-01-19|title=SRI International Elects Dr. Henry Kressel to Board of Directors|publisher=[[SRI International]]|date=2012-01-15|accessdate=2012-01-15}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Kressel's parents and sister were murdered in [[The Holocaust]] during [[World War II]], after which Kressel emigrated to the United States. He entered [[Yeshiva Rabbi Chaim Berlin|Chaim Berlin High School]] in 1947 and graduated in 1951.<ref name="yu">{{cite web|url=http://www.yu.edu/support/meet-donors/kressel/|title=Dr. Henry Kressel|publisher=yu.edu. [[Yeshiva University]]|accessdate=2012-01-15}}</ref>

Kressel earned a bachelor's degree in physics from [[Yeshiva College (Yeshiva University)|Yeshiva College]], a master's in applied physics from [[Harvard University]], an MBA from [[The Wharton School]] at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] and a Ph.D. in material science, also from the University of Pennsylvania.<ref name="wp"/>

==Career==
Kressel joined [[Sarnoff Corporation|RCA Laboratories]] in 1959, and spent 23 years there.<ref name="elects"/><ref name="cal">{{cite web|url=http://www.pickar.caltech.edu/e103/guestbios.html|title=E/ME 103: Management of Technology: Guest Bios|publisher=[[California Institute of Technology]]|accessdate=2012-01-15}}</ref> He was in charge of development and commercialization of research developments in a variety of fields including light sources, light detectors, and integrated circuits. The development of the first practical [[laser diode]]s and the first [[epitaxial]] silicon [[solar cell]] are also attributed to him.<ref name="elects"/> He eventually became vice president of solid-state electronic research and development.<ref name="wp"/><ref name="elects"/>

Kressel joined [[Warburg Pincus]] in 1983.<ref name="wp"/>

==Memberships and awards==
Kressel received an honorary doctorate from [[Yeshiva University]].<ref name="wp"/> He is a 1974 [[IEEE Fellow]] and was the founding president of [[IEEE Photonics Society|IEEE Lasers and Electro-Optics Society]] in 1977.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.ieee.org/membership_services/membership/fellows/chronology/fellows_1974.html |title=Fellow Class of 1974 |publisher=[[IEEE]] |accessdate=2012-01-15 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110629165241/http://www.ieee.org/membership_services/membership/fellows/chronology/fellows_1974.html |archivedate=2011-06-29 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://photonicssociety.org/content/our-history|title=Our History|publisher=photonicssociety.org. [[IEEE Photonics Society]]|accessdate=2012-01-15|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120114034255/http://photonicssociety.org/content/our-history|archive-date=2012-01-14|url-status=dead}}</ref> He received the [[IEEE Centennial Medal]] in 1984 and the [[IEEE David Sarnoff Award]] in 1985 for "contributions to electronic devices".<ref name="wp"/><ref name="cal"/> He was elected to the [[National Academy of Engineering]] in 1980<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nae.edu/MembersSection/Directory20412/29062.aspx |title=NAE Members Directory - Dr. Henry Kressel|publisher=[[National Academy of Engineering]] |accessdate=2012-01-22}}</ref> and is a Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref name="yu"/>

He is on the [[board of directors]] of [[SRI International]], [[Aicent]], [[EnStorage]], MACH, [[Suniva]] and [[Telcordia Technologies]].<ref name="wp"/><ref name="sri"/> He has been on the board of directors of Yeshiva University's [[Sy Syms School of Business]] since 2004, and is the chairman of the board of trustees of Yeshiva University.<ref name="yu"/><ref>{{cite news|url=http://blogs.yu.edu/news/2004/07/07/henry-kressel-elected-to-board-of-directors-of-yeshiva-university%E2%80%99s-sy-syms-school-of-business/ |title=Henry Kressel Elected to Board of Directors of Yeshiva University's Sy Syms School of Business |publisher=[[Yeshiva University]] |date=2004-07-07 |accessdate=2012-01-15 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20111001171411/http://blogs.yu.edu/news/2004/07/07/henry-kressel-elected-to-board-of-directors-of-yeshiva-university%E2%80%99s-sy-syms-school-of-business/ |archivedate=2011-10-01 }}</ref>

In 2008, Kressel created a scholarship at Yeshiva University in his own name, the Henry Kressel Research Scholarship.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://blogs.yu.edu/news/2008/10/29/four-undergraduates-receive-henry-kressel-research-scholarships-to-pursue-research-projects-in-diverse-fields/ |title=Four Undergraduates Receive Henry Kressel Research Scholarships to Pursue Research Projects in Diverse Fields |publisher=[[Yeshiva University]] |date=2008-10-29 |accessdate=2012-01-15 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130316165609/http://blogs.yu.edu/news/2008/10/29/four-undergraduates-receive-henry-kressel-research-scholarships-to-pursue-research-projects-in-diverse-fields/ |archivedate=2013-03-16 }}</ref>

==Patents and publications==
Kressel holds 33 United States patents and has published more than 120 papers.<ref name="elects"/><ref name="ibf">{{cite web|url=http://www.israelibusinessforum.org/content/events/past_events/2010-7-12-Kressel.html |title=How Does VC Create Value in the Current World Environment? |publisher=Israeli Business Forum |accessdate=2012-01-15 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100807024519/http://www.israelibusinessforum.org/content/events/past_events/2010-7-12-Kressel.html |archivedate=2010-08-07 }}</ref> He has also published six books:<ref name="ibf"/>
* {{cite book|title=Characterization of Epitaxial Semiconductor Films (Methods and Phenomena: Their Applications in Science and Technology, Vol. 2)|date=1976-04-01|publisher=[[Elsevier]]|isbn=0-444-41438-X}}
* {{cite book|title=Semiconductor Lasers and Heterojunction LEDS|publisher=[[Academic Press]]|year=1977|isbn=0-12-426250-3}}
* {{cite book|title=Competing for the Future: How Digital Innovations are Changing the World|publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]]|year=2007|isbn=978-0-521-86290-5|url=https://archive.org/details/competingforfutu0000kres_t1i8}}
* {{cite book|title=Investing in Dynamic Markets: Venture Capital in the Digital Age|publisher=Cambridge University Press|date=July 2010|isbn=978-0-521-11148-5|url=https://archive.org/details/investingindynam0000kres}}
* {{cite book|title=Entrepreneurship in the Global Economy: Engine for Economic Growth|publisher=Cambridge University Press|date=August 2012|isbn=978-1-107-01976-8}}
* {{cite book|title=If You Really Want to Change the World: A Guide to Creating, Building, and Sustaining Breakthrough Ventures|publisher=Harvard Business Review|date=October 2015|isbn=978-1-625-27829-6}}
